DnsEntry.description: A DNS entry for the endpoint.

HostedZoneId.description: The ID of the private hosted zone.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key of the tag. Tag keys are case-sensitive, accept a maximum of 127 Unicode characters, and may not begin with aws:.

schema.description: Resource Type definition for AWS::EC2::VPCEndpointConnection. A connection between an interface or Gateway Load Balancer VPC endpoint created by a service consumer and a VPC endpoint service owned by the caller. A connection comes into existence implicitly when a consumer creates an endpoint to the caller's endpoint service; there is no API that creates one directly, so this is a read-only resource.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the VPC endpoint connection.

CreationTimestamp.description: The date and time that the VPC endpoint connection was created.

DnsEntries.description: The DNS entries for the VPC endpoint.

IpAddressType.description: The IP address type of the VPC endpoint.

NetworkLoadBalancerArns.description: The Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of the network load balancers for the service.

ServiceId.description: The ID of the VPC endpoint service to which the endpoint is connected.

Tags.description: The tags assigned to the VPC endpoint connection.

VpcEndpointConnectionId.description: The ID of the VPC endpoint connection.

VpcEndpointId.description: The ID of the VPC endpoint that is connected to the service.

VpcEndpointOwner.description: The ID of the Amazon Web Services account that owns the VPC endpoint.

VpcEndpointRegion.description: The Region of the VPC endpoint that is connected to the service.

VpcEndpointState.description: The state of the VPC endpoint connection, for example pendingAcceptance, pending, available, deleting, deleted, rejected or failed.
